# Train a model 

## A simple model of TCR burden

Simply add up the number of TCRs per mutation and use the burden to predict mutation status.

```{r}

# Fast AUC via ranks (assumes y is 0/1). 
fast_auc <- function(y, pred, direction = "<") {
  if (!all(y %in% c(0, 1))) stop("y must be binary 0/1")
  if (all(y == 0) || all(y == 1) || all(!is.finite(pred))) return(NA_real_)
  p <- pred
  if (identical(direction, ">")) p <- -p
  r <- rank(p, ties.method = "average")
  n1 <- sum(y == 1L); n0 <- sum(y == 0L)
  U <- sum(r[y == 1L]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2
  as.numeric(U / (n1 * n0))
}

y = rep(0:1, each = 50)
x = c(rnorm(50, 2, 1), rnorm(50, 3, 1))
fast_auc(y, x)

auc(y, x, quiet=TRUE, direction="<")

get_prediction_fast <- function(res_A, res_B, mut_mat, TCR_A_mat, TCR_B_mat,
                                verbose = TRUE) {

  # 2) All mutations we will iterate
  muts <- sort(unique(c(res_A$mut, res_B$mut)))

  # 3) Precompute mutation->row index in mut_mat
  mut_idx <- match(muts, rownames(mut_mat))

  # 4) Precompute counts and max single-TCR AUCs per mut
  nA_by_mut <- table(res_A$mut)
  nB_by_mut <- table(res_B$mut)
  
  get_max_auc <- 
    function(x){ if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else max(x, na.rm = TRUE)}

  maxA_by_mut <- tapply(res_A$auc, res_A$mut, get_max_auc)
  maxB_by_mut <- tapply(res_B$auc, res_B$mut, get_max_auc)

  # 5) Precompute lists of TCR names per mut
  A_TCRs_by_mut <- split(res_A$TCR, res_A$mut)
  B_TCRs_by_mut <- split(res_B$TCR, res_B$mut)

  # 6) Map TCR names to row indices once
  A_row_map <- setNames(seq_len(nrow(TCR_A_mat)), rownames(TCR_A_mat))
  B_row_map <- setNames(seq_len(nrow(TCR_B_mat)), rownames(TCR_B_mat))
  
  get_tcr <- function(v, row_map) unname(row_map[v[!is.na(v) & v %in% names(row_map)]])
  A_rows_by_mut <- lapply(A_TCRs_by_mut, get_tcr, row_map = A_row_map)
  B_rows_by_mut <- lapply(B_TCRs_by_mut, get_tcr, row_map = B_row_map)

  # 7) Allocate result and container for predictors (same schema as your function)
  res <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(muts), ncol = 7)
  colnames(res) <- c("n_alpha","n_beta",
                     "auc_alpha","auc_alpha_single_TCR_max",
                     "auc_beta","auc_beta_single_TCR_max",
                     "auc_both")
  TCR_pred <- vector("list", length(muts))
  names(TCR_pred) <- muts

  # 8) Main loop
  n_samples <- ncol(mut_mat)
  zero_vec <- rep(0, n_samples)

  for (i in seq_along(muts)) {
    if (verbose && (i %% 1000 == 0)) cat(i, " / ", length(muts), "\n")
    mut_i <- muts[i]
    idx_i <- mut_idx[i]
    if (is.na(idx_i)) { stop("missing mutation") }

    y_i <- as.numeric(mut_mat[idx_i, ])

    A_rows <- A_rows_by_mut[[mut_i]]
    B_rows <- B_rows_by_mut[[mut_i]]

    if (!is.null(A_rows) && length(A_rows)){
      TCRA_i <- colSums(TCR_A_mat[A_rows, , drop = FALSE])
    }else{
      TCRA_i <- zero_vec
    }

    if (!is.null(B_rows) && length(B_rows)){
      TCRB_i <-  colSums(TCR_B_mat[B_rows, , drop = FALSE])
    }else{
      TCRB_i <- zero_vec
    }
    TCRAB_i <- TCRA_i + TCRB_i

    # Fill counts
    res[i, 1] <- as.integer(nA_by_mut[mut_i]) # n_alpha
    res[i, 2] <- as.integer(nB_by_mut[mut_i]) # n_beta

    # AUCs (direction "<" to mirror your pROC call)
    res[i, 3] <- fast_auc(y_i, TCRA_i, direction = "<")
    res[i, 5] <- fast_auc(y_i, TCRB_i, direction = "<")
    res[i, 7] <- fast_auc(y_i, TCRAB_i, direction = "<")

    # single-TCR max AUCs
    res[i, 4] <- as.numeric(maxA_by_mut[mut_i])
    res[i, 6] <- as.numeric(maxB_by_mut[mut_i])

    # Keep TCR lists
    TCR_pred[[i]] <- list(TCRA = A_TCRs_by_mut[[mut_i]],
                          TCRB = B_TCRs_by_mut[[mut_i]])
  }

  rownames(res) <- muts
  list(res = data.frame(res, check.names = FALSE), TCR_predictors = TCR_pred)
}

```

## Visualize results

```{r fig.width = 4.5, fig.height=3}
summary(res_A$pval_LRT)
summary(res_B$pval_LRT)

pcuts = list(pcut_A = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1), 
             pcut_B = c(0.05, 0.10, 0.2))

df1 = data.frame(pcut_A = pcuts$pcut_A, 
                 pcut_B = pcuts$pcut_B, 
                 n_alpha = sapply(pcuts$pcut_A, function(p1){sum(res_A$pval_LRT < p1)}), 
                 n_beta = sapply(pcuts$pcut_B, function(p1){sum(res_B$pval_LRT < p1)}))
df1

res_list = list()

for(i in 1:nrow(df1)){
  res_A1 = res_A[which(res_A$pval_LRT < df1$pcut_A[i]),]
  res_B1 = res_B[which(res_B$pval_LRT < df1$pcut_B[i]),]
  res1 = get_prediction_fast(res_A1, res_B1, mut_mat, TCR_A_mat, TCR_B_mat)

  g1 = ggplot(data = res1$res, aes(x = log10(n_alpha + 1), y = auc_alpha)) +
    geom_pointdensity() + ggtitle(sprintf("TCR-alpha, pval < %.1e", df1$pcut_A[i])) + 
    scale_color_viridis()
  print(g1)
  
  g1 = ggplot(data = res1$res, aes(x = log10(n_beta + 1), y = auc_beta)) +
    geom_pointdensity() + ggtitle(sprintf("TCR-beta, pval < %.1e", df1$pcut_B[i])) + 
    scale_color_viridis()
  print(g1)

  gg_hist <- function(df1, x_var, pcut_A, pcut_B){
    g1 = ggplot(df1, aes(x=.data[[x_var]])) + 
      geom_histogram(color="darkblue", fill="lightblue", 
                     breaks=seq(0.38,1, by=0.02)) + 
       ggtitle(sprintf("p[A] < %.1e, p[B] < %.1e", df1$pcut_A[i], df1$pcut_B[i]))
    print(g1)
  }
  
  gg_hist(res1$res, "auc_alpha", df1$pcut_A[i], df1$pcut_B[i])
  gg_hist(res1$res, "auc_beta",  df1$pcut_B[i], df1$pcut_B[i])
  gg_hist(res1$res, "auc_both",  df1$pcut_B[i], df1$pcut_B[i])
  
  res_ab = res1$res[order(res1$res$auc_both, decreasing = TRUE),]
  res_ab$mut = rownames(res_ab)

  fwrite(res_ab, 
         file=file.path(result_dir, sprintf("TCGA_res_AUC_pA_%.1e_pB_%.1e.tsv", 
                                            df1$pcut_A[i], df1$pcut_B[i])), 
         sep="\t")

  saveRDS(res1$TCR_predictors, 
          file = file.path(result_dir, 
                           sprintf("TCGA_res_TCR_predictors_pval_pA_%.1e_pB_%.1e.rds", 
                                   df1$pcut_A[i], df1$pcut_B[i])))
  res_list[[i]] = res_ab
}

```
